extension.description: Securely include whitelisted PHP files in Joomla articles and Custom HTML modules.

field.name: allowed_files
field.label: Allowed PHP files
field.description: One file per line. File names only; no directory path.

field.name: include_directory
field.label: Include directory
field.description: Directory relative to the Joomla root, for example includes/php. Leave empty to use the Joomla root.

field.name: allowed_modules
field.label: Allowed Custom HTML module IDs
field.description: One module ID per line. Only these Custom HTML modules can use PHP include tags.

field.name: keyword
field.label: Keyword
field.description: The keyword used to include a file. For example, "phpinclude" produces {phpinclude:filename.php}. The colon is fixed.

field.name: show_errors
field.label: Show error messages
field.description: Show an error in content when a file is missing or not whitelisted, instead of a hidden HTML comment.
